title: Rebuild append-only Method Flow from the immutable x1 baseline
trigger_preconditions: x1 commit is immutable and ancestral
x2 evidence builder may be rerun
failure_signature: The second evidence-builder invocation appended the two post-freeze incidents again, producing duplicate method identifiers and invalid 11-method counts.
candidate_workaround: For repeatable lifecycle builders, take the immutable frozen-phase blob as the append base and materialize the full reviewed append set deterministically.
recurrence_guard: Assert unique method and witness identifiers after every rebuild and before writing the worktree ledger.
rollback: Keep validation failed, preserve the duplicate-append incident, and do not delete historical evidence without rebuilding it from the immutable baseline.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-local operational recovery only; no scientific, professional, authority, production, security-complete, accessibility-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
